note: P4313 (Pro 28:3) — a poor man who oppresses the poor is a beating rain that leaves no food.

dims.v: cruel exploitation — a poor man grinding his fellow-poor
the oppression of the poor by one who is himself poor — the peculiar cruelty of the low crushing the low, ruinous as a beating rain that flattens the crop and leaves no food
the exploitation that, coming from a fellow-sufferer, ruins utterly

ashaq (oppress/exploit) — 'a poor man who OPPRESSES the poor is a beating rain that leaves no food'; when the oppressed turn oppressor, the cruelty is total — like a storm that beats down the very crop meant to feed. The low crushing the low leaves nothing.
